scope.allowed: Decorative wave paths and their existing four static junctions only; dark production Overview scope.
preserve: all real labels/numbers and observed charts

caveat: Earlier bright-count/envelope ROI [500,180,560,320) includes Source dotted orbital curves. Its 567 versus 425 pixels and 63.4 versus 42px y10–90 span do not isolate PulseAmbient. Do not optimize amplitude from that statistic.

current.placement: left:calc(50% - 375px); width:760px; height:100%; canonical production top:-9px; parent transform translate(21px,-19px)

trials.purpose: Test whether sharper, brighter existing filaments reduce the gap independently of geometry.
trials.unchanged: All path d, widths, gradient stops, stars and junctions. Target only six wave paths and their soft-glow filter; not star-glow.

trials.purpose: Test Source crossing-band placement; current visible left lobes sit higher.
trials.unchanged: No SVG root/parent/CSS movement, orbit movement, atmosphere or star movement. All path shape, paint, junction count and junction shape unchanged.

trials.purpose: Test bounded nonuniform curvature while keeping each original fundamental and mean band.

exactChanges.cubicConstruction: Keep WIDTH/64 Hermite segments and use exact dy/dx above for both control handles.
exactChanges.junctionY: Use modified waveY at existing junction x; no extra junctions.

trials.unchanged: No group translation, paint changes, CSS box or orbit change. Maximum perturbation <=0.26*A; no unbounded amplitude multiplier.

trials.purpose: Only evaluate combination after individual trials show which changes help.

exactChanges.composition: Combine only individually supported tone-only, registration-only, irregularity-only changes; report the exact included trial IDs. Do not automatically combine all three.

trials.gate: Skip if no isolated trial improves masked spatial/photometric comparison without spill.

measurement.coordinates: Half-open pixel rectangles at immutable Source viewport; never rescale screenshots independently.
masks: Exclude all metric text, quota numbers, progress arcs, model panel, metric traces, globe and orbit ridges with >=3px dilation.
Manually identify orbital/dotted arcs from enlarged Source/current crops before measuring. A simple radial exclusion cannot separate tilted ellipses.
Use the union of source/current excluded ridge masks so one image does not benefit from asymmetrical masking.
Use broad context ROI only for inspection, never raw score; Source factual text and ring progress differ.
measurement.registration: Use unchanged panel/header anchors to register entire screenshots with only global dx,dy in {-1,0,1}. Retain same ROIs for baseline and trials. Do not independently translate wings to maximize match, because registration-only trial itself is under test. For geometry-isolated paint analysis only, additionally report ridge-normal profiles after matching the same decorative filament; clearly separate this from fixed-position results.
metrics: Masked RGB absolute error with paired registration results, not overall app percent.
Cyan/violet ridge y-centroid and y10–90 span in each primary ROI after orbit exclusion; report bright-pixel count only as a diagnostic.
Perpendicular ridge core width and brightness/halo falloff on several manually paired unoccluded filaments; distinguish shape error from hue.
Changed-pixel mask: six waves/junctions may change, text/ring/globe/model paint may not. Any spill invalidates the trial.
measurement.acceptance: No candidate is approved now. Inspect both wings; reject gains caused by masking away a misplaced lobe or by brighter bloom washing into text/core. Require repeatable improvement across paired +/-1px registrations, with no new semantic/motion or light/narrow regression. Root chooses production changes only after actual trial evidence.
